summary: DaVita Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Ninth Amendment to its existing Credit Agreement, which adds a $500 million incremental borrowing under its Tranche B-2 Term Loan facility due 2031. The terms include interest rate options of Term SOFR plus 175 bps or Base Rate plus 75 bps. No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event is present; this is a routine debt financing arrangement. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.
